analysis.rules: units: replicas; estimators: pooled ratio with delete-one jackknife SE; sector: N*Szz(0)/count > 0.5; paired z = mean(delta_r)/(sd/sqrt(n)), undetermined when SE is 0 or non-finite; precision: dE/N<=4e-4, d(3Szz)<=0.03, and every criterion whose runs miss it is undetermined/precision; criteria 1-6 of spec 7.2 only in production mode with the expected replica count; verdict pass only when all six pass; pilot mode: descriptive only; not a scientific adoption

ED_reference.interpretation: Differences include finite-temperature and Trotter effects as well as statistical uncertainty; no separate bias estimate was obtained.

limitations: The sector statistic uses adjacent saved bins, not individual accepted proposals or physical transition counts.
Same-seed pairing does not make the fixed and polarized trajectories identical.
Acceptance gains alone do not establish better mixing or sufficient equilibration.
Single-run cost ratios include execution variability and are not isolated algorithm-overhead estimates.
This finite-condition effect verdict does not establish scientific adoption of U>=8 DQMC values.
